test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating User Picker custom field values across OKR views
test.description:
This test verifies updating User Picker custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving User Picker custom field values
* Selecting and updating single user values
* Selecting and updating multiple user values
* Adding and removing selected users
* Verifying selected users are displayed correctly across all supported views
* Verifying user avatars and names are displayed correctly
* Correct User Picker dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

* User custom field (*with Allow multiple users*) is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for User fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values

steps.data: boxName: TC-6165 SPM - OKR - Updating User Picker custom field values across OKR views
steps.result:
Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1

User custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

* Strategic Theme - "Admin 1"
* Objective - "Admin 1, Admin 2"

!xray-attachment://e2849f69-0e46-46a5-bb48-3067cc7740e1|width=443,height=184!

Only user avatars are displayed for User Picker custom field values.

For the Key Result item, four user avatars and the "+2" button are displayed correctly

steps.result:

Clear button is displayed for individual selected user and for the entire custom field

steps.result:

!xray-attachment://718ba123-97a6-47ad-adf9-a6423d88cd35|width=384,height=343!

steps.action: Navigate to the Key result User custom field and hover over to first user value

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Key result row

steps.result:
The new field value is saved. 
Field displays 2 users: Admin 1, Admin 2

steps.action: Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
steps.result: Detail page is opened. User field is visible with correct value.

steps.action: Navigate to the Key result User custom field and add the value

The new field value is saved.
Field displays 3 users: Admin 1, Admin 2, Admin 3. 
Only user avatars is visible

rag.text:
Test: TC-6165 — SPM - OKR - Updating User Picker custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating User Picker custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving User Picker custom field values
* Selecting and updating single user values
* Selecting and updating multiple user values
* Adding and removing selected users
* Verifying selected users are displayed correctly across all supported views
* Verifying user avatars and names are displayed correctly
* Correct User Picker dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* User custom field (*with Allow multiple users*) is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for User fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6165 SPM - OKR - Updating User Picker custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to User field
   Expected: User custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "Admin 1"
* Objective - "Admin 1, Admin 2"
* Key Result - "Admin 1, Admin 2, Admin 3, Admin 4, Admin 5, Admin 6"

!xray-attachment://e2849f69-0e46-46a5-bb48-3067cc7740e1|width=443,height=184!

Only user avatars are displayed for User Picker custom field values.

For the Key Result item, four user avatars and the "+2" button are displayed correctly
4. Navigate to the Strategic theme User custom field and click on field value
   Expected: User Picker dropdown is displayed with selected user, available users list and recent users section

Clear button is displayed for individual selected user and for the entire custom field
5. Click clear for individual selected value (Admin 1)
   Expected: Selected value is removed and dropdown remains available for selecting new values


!xray-attachment://718ba123-97a6-47ad-adf9-a6423d88cd35|width=384,height=343!
6. Click outside the field
   Expected: Dropdown is closed and the User field remains empty after clicking outside the field
7. Navigate to the Key result User custom field and hover over to first user value
   Expected: Tooltip with userName: Admin 1 is displayed
8. Click on +2 button
   Expected: Popover with hidden User Picker values is displayed and contains additional selected users with correct avatars and full names

!xray-attachment://052677bd-e282-41c2-8e51-2fbe5dc6ca39|width=536,height=246!
9. Click on field value again
   Expected: User Picker dropdown is displayed with all selected users with full names
Clear button is displayed for individual selected user and for the entire custom field


!xray-attachment://ba25283d-847a-46d7-ba11-8298b4587fd8|width=552,height=287!
10. Click Clear button for entire field and change the value
   Data: newValue: Admin 1
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
11. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. User field is visible with correct value.
12. Navigate to the Key result User custom field and add the value
   Data: newValue: Admin 2
   Expected: The new field value is saved. 
Field displays 2 users: Admin 1, Admin 2
13. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. User field is visible with correct value.
14. Navigate to the Key result User custom field and add the value
   Data: newValue: Admin 3
   Expected: The new field value is saved.
Field displays 3 users: Admin 1, Admin 2, Admin 3. 
Only user avatars is visible
